# American Exchange Group

American Exchange Group is a Wholesale company. American Exchange Group is an industry leader in fashion accessory products and brand management. They offer a diverse portfolio of global brands and have strong relationships with ecommerce and digital expertise. They also provide quality and design services, distribution, global supply chain, and network. American Exchange Group employs 227 people (+26.8% YoY, +48 people) and has an annual revenue of $50M. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States, with an office in Miami. Its workforce is distributed across 10 countries (including United States, El Salvador, Peru, Panama, and Belgium).

## About

American Exchange Group is an industry leader in fashion accessory products and brand management. By facilitating distribution to major retailers internationally for their globally recognized brands, custom private label brands, and exclusive licensed brands—including footwear, tech wearables, watches, jewelry, handbags, fashion accessories, and beauty—American Exchange Group raises the bar by disrupting the status quo with value and quality, while staying at the forefront of trends.

Expertise in brand strategy, marketing, sourcing, operational logistics, and digital innovation allows American Exchange Group to transform brands and forge connections with best-in-class, strategic and retail partners. Their consumer-centric approach ensures sustainable growth and long-term value. Boasting a comprehensive portfolio of iconic owned and licensed brands, 
American Exchange Group remains at the forefront of the industry, driving the creation of compelling brand experiences.

## About

American Exchange Group is a multi-division New York based designer, manufacturer and wholesaler of fashion accessory watches, jewelry and footwear for major retailers. The company has private label brands as well as licensed brands including Nicole Miller, English Laundry, Joseph Abbou, ROCAWEAR, Adrienne Vittadini, and Jones New York. The company has a market leading tech/wearables category with iTOUCH Wearables. The company also has a robust online presence with warehousing and drop-shipping capabilities for consumer purchases in multiple divisions.
